sloka: भ्रातृ पुत्र समौ च अपि द्रष्टव्यौ च विशेषतः ।त्वया लक्ष्मण शत्रुघ्नौ प्राणैः प्रियतरौ मम ॥२-२६-३३॥
transliteration: bhrātṛ putra samau ca api draṣṭavyau ca viśeṣataḥ ।tvayā lakṣmaṇa śatrughnau prāṇaiḥ priyatarau mama ॥2-26-33॥

translations.english: What is more important is that you should look on Bharata as your brother and Satrughna as your son. They are dearer to me than my life.
